aboutme.headline: About me
aboutme.paragraph1: Hey there, I'm André, a junior full-stack developer from near Cologne. I have been building frontends for the longest time, and I enjoy the backend side with Django REST Framework just as much. What drives me is turning everyday problems into simple, useful web applications.
aboutme.paragraph2: I learn from every challenge and keep looking for the clean, efficient solution. Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

skills.headline: Skill set
skills.text: I work with modern front-end technologies like Angular and TypeScript and build APIs with Python and Django. I'm always open to learning new tools and adapting to what a project needs.

projects.headline: Projects
projects.description: Take a look at my projects and try them out. Each one shows my approach to building responsive, user-friendly applications with clean and efficient code.

join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
join.details: Developed in a team of developers using an agile workflow with clearly distributed tasks and regular code reviews via Git. I implemented the board view with drag and drop as well as the task forms, and learned how to coordinate features and merge branches cleanly in a team.

valhalla-rush.description: 2D jump and run game with a Norse theme. Run, jump and fight your way through enemies, collect items and defeat the final boss.
valhalla-rush.details: Built independently with object-oriented JavaScript and the HTML5 canvas. I structured the game into classes for characters, enemies and objects, and implemented the game loop, collision detection, animations and sound. This project taught me how to plan a larger codebase with inheritance and clean class responsibilities.

pokedex.description: Pokédex based on the PokéAPI. Browse Pokémon, search by name and view detailed stats, types and abilities in an overlay.
pokedex.details: Built independently with JavaScript, HTML and CSS. I fetched the data asynchronously from a REST API, loaded Pokémon in batches to keep the app fast and rendered them dynamically. I learned how to work with async/await, handle API responses and build a responsive card layout.

coderr.description: REST API for a freelancer platform where businesses offer services in three packages and customers can place orders and write reviews.
coderr.details: Built independently with Python and Django REST Framework. I implemented authentication, business and customer profiles, offers with filtering, search, sorting and pagination, orders and reviews, all covered by tests. The API runs with PostgreSQL in Docker and is deployed on my own server. Working through mentor reviews taught me to follow an API specification precisely and to keep views slim.

videoflix.description: Video streaming platform backend. Users register, activate their account by email and stream videos in different resolutions.
videoflix.details: Built independently with Python and Django REST Framework. I implemented token-based authentication with account activation and password reset via email, automatic video conversion into multiple resolutions with FFmpeg in background jobs, and HLS streaming. The project runs in Docker with PostgreSQL and Redis.

items.second: During our course at the Developer Akademie, Andre and I spent many evenings coding together, and I really enjoyed that time. He almost always had a solution when I got stuck, and whenever I doubted myself, he lifted me back up.

hosting.title: Hosting and server log files
hosting.text: This website is hosted by Hostinger. When you visit the site, the server automatically stores technical data such as your IP address, browser type and time of access. This is necessary to deliver the website securely (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.text: If you send me a message via the contact form, I process your name, email address and message only to answer your request (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). The data is sent to me by email and deleted as soon as it is no longer needed.

localStorage.title: Local storage
localStorage.text: Your language selection (English/German) is saved in your browser's local storage so that the site remembers it on your next visit. This is technically necessary for the function you requested (§ 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG). No tracking or analytics tools are used.
